item.title: Annapolis Community Grant Portal Now Open
item.description: The Office of Community Services has opened the application portal for the City of Annapolis FY 2027 Community Grant program.

item.title: Obsessions: Edible Favors
item.description: Don’t have a favor that gets left behind at the end of the night! These edible options will give guests something to snack on and remember the night later.

item.title: Sugar vs. Sugar vs. Sugar?
item.description: What’s the difference between all these types of sugar?

item.title: DNR Extends Maryland Commercial Oyster Season for Two Additional Weeks
item.description: Extended season is being put in place to help watermen who have been unable to harvest due to ice-covered waterways

item.title: DNR Study: Bowfishing Contributes Heavily to Chesapeake Channa Harvest
item.description: A new Maryland Department of Natural Resources study revealed that bowfishing and gigging – using a pronged spear – are the most common ways Chesapeake Channa (also known as northern snakehead) are harvested in Maryland.

item.title: Crofton High School Leads the Way as 10 County High Schools Earn AP Honor Roll Distinctions
item.description: Crofton High School made Anne Arundel County Public Schools history and nine other schools joined the Cardinals by earning recognitions on the College Board’s AP School Honor Roll.

item.title: ShoreRivers Shares 2026 Legislative Priorities
item.description: Now that the Maryland General Assembly has reconvened for the 448th Legislative Session, ShoreRivers’ advocacy efforts are in full swing.

item.title: Talbot County Invites Community to Participate in Talbot Day 2026 Poster Contest
item.description: Talbot County is gearing up for the 2026 Talbot Day Celebration, and the community is invited to engage in two longtime traditions: the Talbot Day Poster Contest and the Talbot Citizen & Service Awards.

item.title: Hello Beautiful Film Screening
item.description: Hello Beautiful is an inspiring story of resilience in the face of breast cancer.

item.title: The Books I Almost Didn’t Finish (But I’m Glad I Did)
item.description: Not every book pulls you in immediately. Some take their time. Some feel dense. Some make you wonder if you’re just not in the right mood — or not the right reader. Here are five books I almost set aside — but didn’t. And I’m grateful I stayed.
